topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture's scope and objectives regarding the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular criteria and spatial requirements that allow innate immune sensors to distinguish microbial and damaged non-self from self.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptor Families and Signaling Platforms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the major families of innate pattern recognition receptors and the intracellular signaling pathways and complexes that trigger inflammatory mediator production.

topics.label: Leukocyte Mobilization and Physiological Consequences of Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory activation coordinates the local and systemic trafficking of immune cells as well as the clinical risks of severe systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how acute inflammatory responses are resolved, how damaged tissues are repaired, and how persistent insults lead to chronic or protective containment states.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding closing remarks and announces the subject of the subsequent lecture.
